_method: No LLM. Frames captured with crystalsight.channels.tui.load_crystal + mat_viewer.tui.TerminalSession(100x36, ascii7): default, align a/b/c, orbit, zoom x2, set_display label_mode=label/atom level, molecule level, fit. Atom counts from tui_probe_summary.json. Verdict = whether the information needed for the gold is perceivable from frames with the actions the CrystalSight TUI channel allows.
_global_findings: Scene = one unit cell + boundary replicas of whole molecules (load_for_tui display_mode=unit_cell); no supercell / neighbour shell, so contacts across cell faces are only partly visible.

Default display for all 14 structures is level=molecule (hull/centroid outlines with a formula tag) because atom_count > 64; at atom level label_mode=auto resolves to 'dot' (>160 atoms) or 'element' (>32 atoms), so atom LABELS appear only after set_display label_mode='label'.

The CrystalSight channel GUIDE advertises label_mode auto|element|none: 'none' is rejected by mat-vis (valid: auto,label,element,molecule,dot) and 'label' is never mentioned, so a model following the guide cannot get atom labels.
All symmetry copies carry the identical CIF label (no image/symop suffix), so the reference molecule (x,y,z copy) cannot be singled out.

No H-bond / short-contact overlay, no distance query (select/focus refused by the channel), no scale bar and cell parameters are not shown; ascii7 drops the colour-only depth tiers, so depth ordering is ambiguous.
Zoomed label views of small cells (<=150 atoms) are legible (see ccdc_S02 frames); 400-700-atom cells are cluttered with overlapping labels (see cod_2003349/09_align_b_label_zoom2.5.txt).
